decisions.proposed_text: Bố là một quý ông nổi tiếng, đồng thời là nhà từ thiện trong giới Mã Nương
decisions.reason: Generic 赛马娘 must use the project world term Mã Nương rather than Uma Musume.

Yoshie Isogai is canonicalized, but the remaining creator names are still CJK-only and the zh-CN translator line may be bridge metadata rather than original game credit. Do not publish a partially verified creator-credit block.
decisions.terminology_basis: proper_name.yoshie_isogai → Yoshie Isogai; manual audit requires verified Latin/Roman creator names and verification/removal of bridge translator credits

canonical_finding.concept: Creator/staff credit name needs verified Latin/Roman spelling for Vietnamese release text
canonical_finding.reason: The creator name remains CJK-only in a category-17 release credit and needs a verified Latin/Roman form before acceptance.

decisions.reason: Embedded open canonical finding cf-f03d889fe946e094 blocks 内田哲也 until a verified Latin/Roman creator spelling is established; the bridge translator credit also remains unverified.
Erica Masaki and Satoru Kuwabara are known, but embedded open canonical finding cf-6c4de5e15773b46d still blocks 酒井拓也. A partially romanized creator-credit block is not acceptable.
